name: Natural Connection
body:
You have learned to harness just a touch of nature’s power.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13+

Benefit(s): Choose 2 cantrips from the druid spell list and one 1st-level spell from the druid or ranger spell lists. You may cast the cantrips at will and you may cast the 1st-level spell a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier. Your caster level for these spells is equal to your class level and all three spells use your Wisdom modifier to determine their save DC.
